steps.summary: Opened draft quotation S00023 (customer fwod63-n3 Bench Customer, City Benchville) and added a second order line: product [E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors, quantity 2.00, for which the app filled in a unit price of 140.00 and a 20% tax (line total £280.00). The record saved successfully and the statusbar shows the Quotation (draft) state as current. The quotation now has two lines (Acoustic Bloc Screens 3 × 295.00 = £885.00 and Cabinet with Doors 2 × 140.00 = £280.00) and the app computes an Untaxed Amount of £1,165.00 (TAX 20% £233.00, Total £1,398.00).
Replayed stored procedure s_ff5c36; observed quotation_reference=S00023.

Clicked Confirm on quotation S00023 and it became a sales order. The page now displays the order reference/name S00023 (unchanged, in the breadcrumb and heading) and the status bar's current stage is "Sales Order" (highlighted/checked; the "Quotation" and "Quotation Sent" stages are now inactive). Totals are unchanged from before confirmation: Untaxed Amount £1,755.00, TAX 20% £351.00, Total £2,106.00. The action buttons changed to "Create Invoice" / "Send by Email" / "Preview", consistent with a confirmed order.

Cancelled sales order S00023. Clicking Cancel opened a confirmation wizard ("Are you sure you want to cancel this order?"), which I acknowledged by pressing its "Cancel" button (action_cancel — cancels the order without emailing the customer; the alternative was "Send and cancel"). The form now displays reference S00023 with the Statusbar radio "Cancelled" checked (current), and the order-line/action buttons changed ("Set to Quotation" now offered instead of Confirm). Totals remain Untaxed £1,755.00, TAX 20% £351.00, Total £2,106.00.
